children: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Friday that the nation would not hesitate to conduct further coordinated foreign exchange intervention.
Japan will maintain close communication with financial authorities of other nations on foreign exchange and work to maintain an orderly FX market, Katayama said.
